name: SunDrop: Sunny Days Fall From The Sky Like Raindrops
source:
It's senior year for Parsley and his three friends. They've come a long way as a friend group over their high school years. It's Senior Night today, the night where they get to reminisce and share laughs at least one more time. After this night, everything shifts...

While walking home alone after Senior Night, Parsley encounters a mysterious girl who looks out of this world. She is the girl who brings out Parsley's "true colors". His inner desires. His hatred for the impure.

It is after this night that he will seek the darkness in his friends' hearts. They have to be hiding something from him, right? They're probably all monsters deep down, right? His new mission to find the darkness in each of his friends will bring him to the truth of the world. He is the monster slayer after all.

[From [url=https://ashscratchsoft.itch.io/sunny-days-fall-from-the-sky-like-raindrops]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帕斯利和他的三位好友迎来了高中的最后一年。高中数载，他们这个小团体一路相伴走到了今天。今晚是一年一度的毕业纪念夜，他们至少还能最后聚在一起追忆往昔、畅怀欢笑一次。而在今夜过后，一切都将迎来剧变……

毕业纪念夜散场后，独自步行回家的帕斯利偶遇了一名气质超凡脱俗的神秘少女。正是这名少女唤醒了帕斯利的“真面目”——他内心深处的欲望，以及他对不洁之物的憎恶。

自这一夜起，他开始执着于挖掘朋友们内心深处的黑暗。他们一定有什么事瞒着自己，对吧？骨子里说不定全都是怪物，对吧？揪出每位朋友心中黑暗面的新使命，将指引他触及这个世界的真相——毕竟，他可是猎魔人啊。

[摘自[url=https://ashscratchsoft.itch.io/sunny-days-fall-from-the-sky-like-raindrops]Itch.io[/url]]
